summary: Coal-mine laborer born in Pennsylvania about 1902, son of Leopoldo Ferlaino; brother of Helen Ferlaino Cognetti and John's 2nd great-granduncle.
bio: Frank Ferlaino, whose name was also written Farino, was born in Pennsylvania in 1902 or 1903, a son of Leopoldo Ferlaino and a brother of Helen Ferlaino Cognetti, which makes him John's 2nd great-granduncle. His American birth shows that his father was already settled in Scranton by about 1901. In 1920, at seventeen, he was living at home and working as a coal-mine laborer. He was not the Francesco "Frank" Ferlaino who died in 2007, a later Scranton resident born at San Mango.
